LIME offers local interpretability by creating a simplified model around the prediction, revealing plausible but spurious feature dependencies. Integrated Gradients provide smooth, gradient-based attributions useful for detecting subtle but strong spurious signals. Sensitivity analysis quantifies impact by ablating each feature, allowing us to confirm whether a feature's high score is due to actual influence or noise.
